_doc: Rain on your walks (plugins/rain-walk). windows_file: a JSON file under agent/local/ with { heading, order, windows: { <key>: { label, start_h, end_h } } }. threshold: the chance of rain that counts as wet. schedules: one line per check, e.g. { "label": "rain-walk-morning", "cron": "30 7 * * *", "run": "{node} bin/rain-walk-check --window morning --prewalk", "log": "agent/logs/rain-walk.log" }, and a --summary line. Times are the host's local time.
